sentences.en: Yesterday was my birthday. It was a very special day.
sentences.zh: 昨天是我的生日。这是非常特别的一天。

sentences.en: I got up early and my mother gave me a kiss.
sentences.zh: 我早早起床，妈妈给了我一个吻。

sentences.en: My father had a present for me.
sentences.zh: 我父亲有一份礼物给我。

sentences.en: It was a camera. I was very pleased.
sentences.zh: 是一台照相机。我非常高兴。

sentences.en: I took a picture of my family.
sentences.zh: 我给家人拍了一张照片。

sentences.en: My friends came to the house in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 朋友们下午来到了家里。

sentences.en: We had a good time together, talking and laughing.
sentences.zh: 我们一起度过了美好时光，说说笑笑。

sentences.en: My mother made a big cake with fruit on top.
sentences.zh: 妈妈做了一个上面有水果的大蛋糕。

sentences.en: The cake was the best I had ever tasted.
sentences.zh: 蛋糕是我吃过最好吃的。

sentences.en: I blew out the candles and made a wish.
sentences.zh: 我吹灭了蜡烛，许了一个愿望。

sentences.en: I got many gifts from my family and friends.
sentences.zh: 我收到了家人和朋友的许多礼物。

sentences.en: I was happy because so many people cared about me.
sentences.zh: 我很开心因为这么多人关心我。

sentences.en: It was the best day of the year.
sentences.zh: 这是一年中最好的一天。

sentences.en: My uncle gave me a jewel. It was a small silver ring.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔给了我一件珠宝。是一枚小银戒指。

sentences.en: The ornament on the cake was a beautiful flower.
sentences.zh: 蛋糕上的装饰是一朵美丽的花。

sentences.en: My birth was a happy event for my family.
sentences.zh: 我的出生对我的家庭来说是一件快乐的事。

sentences.en: My sister got married last year. Her marriage was a beautiful event.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐去年结婚了。她的婚礼是一件美丽的事。

sentences.en: I had great pleasure giving a gift to my mother.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴给我妈妈送了礼物。

sentences.en: The surprise party was the best event of the year.
sentences.zh: 惊喜派对是那一年最好的活动。
